name: Beast Snagga Boy

bonuses.name: Beast Snagga
bonuses.text: This Threat gains +2 bonus dice to attacks on targets with the BEAST or SQUIG Keywords.

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

options.name: Snagga Mob
options.text: A mob of 10 or more Beast Snagga Boyz can be led by a Beast Snagga Nob, who has +1 Toughness, Wounds, and Resilience, and replaces their Choppa with a Power Snappa. Additionally, one Beast Snagga Boy in the Mob may be equipped with the Thump Gun.

mobAbilities.name: Mob Rule
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Beast SNagga Boyz gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten Boyz.

note: Printed as "MOB ACTIONS": Snagga Mob, kept as a mob option. Resilience prints "7 (AR 1)"; the Mob Rule text prints "SNagga".
